name: Garb Mac Stairn

attributes.attribute: was a Scottish folk giant in a legend of Cú Chulainn

took a week to defeat the giant Garb Mac Stairn

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Garb Mac Stairn was a Scottish folkloric giant. He appears in a legend of the Irish hero Cú Chulainn. He wanted a bull that the hero owned. He traveled to Ireland and found only a servant. The servant said the house was empty except for a sick mistress. Garb forced his way into the room. He saw a woman suckling a large babe. He poked his finger into the baby's mouth. The baby bit down until it struck bone. Garb and the baby fought to the death. The hero took a week to win. A similar tale is told of Fionn mac Cumhaill.
